notionGuide.title: How to set up Notion import
notionGuide.intro: 3 steps — paste the Token and Parent Page ID into the two fields above.
notionGuide.step1Title: Step 1 · Create an integration, get the Token
notionGuide.step1Body:
1. Open the link below (sign in as a Workspace owner)
2. Click “+ New connection”, name it, choose Internal, create
3. Open the integration’s “•••” → copy the “Internal Integration Secret”
4. That long string starting with ntn_ is your Token — paste into the first field
⚠️ Don’t paste the integration’s name; copy the ntn_… secret
notionGuide.step2Title: Step 2 · Get the Parent Page ID
notionGuide.step2Body:
1. Create a Notion page to hold the notes
2. Open it → top-right “•••” → Copy link
3. The 32-char string at the end of the link is the Parent Page ID — paste into the second field
notionGuide.exampleLabel: Example link (the bold part is the ID):
notionGuide.step3Title: Step 3 · Share the page with the integration (crucial, often missed)
notionGuide.step3Body:
1. Open the parent page → top-right “•••” → Connections → + Add connections
2. Select the integration you created, confirm
❗ Skip this and export fails with “parent page not found” (the integration can’t see your pages by default)
notionGuide.done: Then click “Save all settings” and use “Send to Notion” in the video sidebar.

obsidianGuide.title: How to set up Obsidian import
obsidianGuide.intro: Obsidian needs no token — just the correct Vault name.
obsidianGuide.step1Body:
1. The Vault name is the library name shown in Obsidian (bottom-left vault switcher, or the vault folder name)
2. It must match exactly (case-sensitive)
3. Paste it into the “Obsidian Vault Name” field above
obsidianGuide.step2Body:
1. To place notes in a sub-folder, enter a relative path like Clippings/Videos
2. Leave empty to save at the vault root
3. Obsidian creates the folder if it does not exist
obsidianGuide.howBody: “Send to Obsidian” copies the full note to your clipboard and opens obsidian://new?...&clipboard=true so Obsidian creates and fills the note automatically (so there is no length limit).
obsidianGuide.note: ❗ Obsidian desktop must be installed; a wrong Vault name will fail to open or write to the wrong vault.
obsidianGuide.done: Then click “Save all settings” and use “Send to Obsidian” in the video sidebar.
